subject: CSA dependency ledger and evidence handoff — Finvest security intake
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finvest.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finvest CSA intake — third-party dependency mapping and evidence request

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As part of our CSA/CAIQ review we need a dependency-level ledger that maps Redwood controls to any third-party SaaS, managed services, or cloud provider features that materially affect control fulfillment. Specifically we need: 

- A row-per-dependency ledger (service name, vendor, contract reference, region/residency)
- For each dependency, the CAIQ/CCM control IDs impacted and a short rationale (why the dependency matters for that control)
- The minimum evidence artifact we can accept (policy, config screenshot, signed attestation, log sample, SOC excerpt) and the owner inside Redwood who can provide it

Target timeline: initial ledger + artifacts index within 10 business days; full evidence bundle within 3 weeks.

Can you confirm scope (all hosted and dedicated infra plus any managed vendor services) and whether you can supply an upload location with per-artifact owners?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Engineer, Finvest Corp
laura.chen@finvest.com

--
Attachment: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finvest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finvest CSA intake — third-party dependency mapping and evidence request

Laura — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Confirm scope: hosted API, Dedicated (reserved capacity), and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, plus our managed integrations (cloud DBs, KMS providers, telemetry ingestion).

Marissa / Kimberly / Ben — I'm assigning owners: Kimberly will own the dependency ledger and CAIQ crosswalk; Ben will pull runtime logs and KMS rotation proof; Marissa will coordinate contractual references and SOC excerpts for managed vendors.

Action items (short):
- Kimberly: deliver ledger template + 48-hour ETA for first pass
- Ben: export a sample log retention snapshot and KMS rotation metadata (two-week ETA)
- Marissa: collect vendor SOC/PCI attestations and contract refs (one-week ETA)

We will create a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot ingestion ticket for tracking. If Finvest needs per-control owner attestations, we can provide short owner emails and a signed attestation template.

Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finvest CSA intake — ledger template & evidence gating

On Wed, 15 Aug 2028 at 10:03 -0700, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Laura — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Confirm scope: hosted API, Dedicated (reserved capacity), and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, plus our managed integrations (cloud DBs, KMS providers, telemetry ingestion).

Team — I've sketched a ledger template and gating rules. Key points: 

Ledger columns (proposed): vendor_name | service_name | vendor_contact | contract_ref | region | caaq_control_ids | control_rationale | artifact_type | artifact_owner | artifact_location | acceptance_notes

Acceptable artifact types (examples): 
- Policy/standard (PDF) — signed and dated
- Config screenshot or export (with redacted identifiers)
- Log sample (CSV, 7-day window) and retention proof
- KMS rotation record (pdf) or HSM attestation
- SOC2/SOC3 excerpt or third-party CAIQ response (if vendor supplies)

Gating rules: artifacts must include at least one timebound proof (log sample, rotation timestamp, or signed attestation) for runtime controls; procedural controls may accept policy + owner attestation.

I will populate the first ten dependencies (our public cloud, telemetry pipeline, KMS provider, analytics vendor, metrics exporter) and attach the draft ledger to the shared folder. Expect v0.1 by EOD today. Ben — please prioritize a KMS rotation snapshot (redwood-kms-us-east-1) and a 7-day telemetry retention export. Marissa — please drop vendor SOC excerpts into the /vendor-socs subfolder.

Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--

- kms_rotation_snapshot.pdf (redacted rotation timestamps for redwood-kms-us-east-1)

Thanks,
